Function declaration.description: Declare a typed function with an effects block.

Export function.description: Export a function from an imported module (only exported declarations are visible through `import "... as alias"`).

Lambda expression.description: Anonymous lambda in expression position (e.g. as an argument to a Function parameter).

Lambda bound to let.description: Bind a lambda to a name; call it as ${1:f}(...).

Function type parameter.description: Higher-order function taking a Function value; pass a lambda or a lambda alias.

Function value alias.description: Alias a lambda value and call it through the new name (supported; named fn declarations are not values).

Let binding.description: Bind a value to a name.

Export let.description: Export a top-level let binding from an imported module.

Record declaration.description: Declare a nominal record with typed fields.

Record update (copy with).description: Shallow copy of a record with updated fields (`p with { x = 3 }`).

Export record.description: Export a record type from an imported module (export enum is not supported).

Enum declaration.description: Declare a nullary enum with variants.

Multi-payload enum declaration.description: Declare an enum variant with multiple payload types (`Two(Int, Text)`).

Payload enum declaration.description: Declare an enum with a single-payload variant (`Some(Int)`) and a nullary variant.

Record literal.description: Construct a named record literal with named fields.

Multi-payload constructor.description: Construct a multi-payload enum value (one argument per declared payload type).

Payload constructor.description: Construct an enum payload value; payload type and arity are checked.

Record member access.description: Read a field from a record value (e.g. p.x).

Aliased enum variant.description: Reference a variant through an imported module alias (`geo.Color.Red`).

Prove and verify.description: Create a hash-chained proof and verify it.

Pipe chain.description: Pipe a table through filter and select stages.

Import module as namespace.description: Import a module under a namespace alias; call members as ${2:math}.fn(...). Only top-level fn declarations are exposed.

Namespaced call.description: Call a function from an imported module namespace.

Function-typed let.description: Bind a lambda to a let annotated as Function.

Result function.description: Declare a function that returns a Result.

Match Result.description: Match a Result with Ok(v), Err(e) and wildcard arms.

Match payload enum.description: Match an enum with a payload binding and a nullary arm.

Result propagation.description: Unwrap Ok or return Err from the enclosing Result function.

Try expression.description: Postfix `?` on any expression inside a Result/Any function (returns Err early).

Ask the model.description: Ask the configured AI endpoint; returns Text.

Ask with context.description: Ask the configured AI endpoint with extra context.

SQL query.description: Run a read-only SQL query; returns a Table.

Remember and recall.description: Write a memory key/value, then read it back.

Wait for the user.description: Human-in-the-loop gate; non-interactive runs return Denied.

Round a number.description: Round a decimal to the given number of digits.

Length.description: Length of a list or text as Int.
